|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “[Pilot] 2. While piloting at a system, cumulatively adds 1 to your total battle destiny here. If a battle at a system just ended, may deploy (for free) from hand to replace a pilot character forfeited during that battle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Reserve Pilot (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting at a system, your total battle destiny here is cumulatively +1. If a battle at a system just ended, may deploy (for free) aboard a starship from which you forfeited a pilot character.” '''What changed:''' “[Pilot] 2.” → “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”; removed “cumulatively adds 1 to”; “here.” → “here is cumulatively +1.”; added “aboard a starship”; “hand to replace” → “which you forfeited”; “character forfeited during that battle.” → “character.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards3.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 45. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Reserve Pilot]].
* Later text: [[Reserve Pilot (V) (Virtual Set 3) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
